notes: Peruvian grocery retailer/wholesaler of the Vega family (Corporación Vega; contact domain corporacionvega.pe). Formats under the same brand: 'Vega Supermayorista' (cash & carry), 'Vega Mayorista' (wholesale) and 'Vega Market' (small proximity supermarkets, incl. franchises) — all are included in this chain; the group is 'wholesale' per project config even though most outlets are Vega Market. Gestión 2024-05-06: 62 stores in Lima (43 market, 3 mayoristas, 16 cash & carry) — the most recent official breakdown found. The official store page (checked 2026-09-30) embeds two lists that disagree: the map list has 58 stores (42 Market, 13 Supermayorista, 3 Mayorista) and a second list has 70 named entries (+9 blank) -> raw snapshot in tools/seed/raw/vega-locator-2026-09-30.json; treat the union as candidates to verify. Brand colour from the official logo: #C12A21 (site UI also uses #F11713/#E40616). The old favicon (red check mark, /arquivos/vega-favicon.png) is outdated and was not used. OSM (probe 2026-10-01): only ~6 chain features ('Vega Market' convenience, 'Vega mayorista' brand=Vega, 'Vega Supermayorista' operator=Corporación Vega, 'Corporación Vega'), none with brand:wikidata. 'Vega' is a very common surname/place word in Peru ('Inca Garcilaso de la Vega' schools, 'Las Vegas', 'Bodega Vega', 'Vega Sports', 'Frávega'…): the regex only accepts plain 'Vega', 'Vega <format>…' or 'Corporación Vega…', and only with shop=supermarket/wholesale/convenience/yes (shop=yes is kept because one 'Vega Market' is tagged that way, so a plain 'Vega' shop=yes also matches -> verify against the locator; 'Vega' jewelry/tailor/dentist are not matched).
